title: Encoding a list of arithmetic gates
statement: Encode a list of arithmetic gates over $n$ variables recursively: the empty list is encoded as the single false bit, and a nonempty list is encoded as a true bit followed by the encoding of its first gate and then the encoding of the remaining list.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $n$ determining the input-variable indices
A finite list of arithmetic gates over those variables
